name: Alpha Core ERP Migration
description: Modernizing the legacy SAP environment to Azure Cloud Infrastructure with Zero-Downtime goals.

application_overview.businessFunction: Centralised ERP platform covering procurement, finance, HR, and supply chain for ~2,400 internal users. Mission-critical for daily financial close and regulatory reporting.

availability.azReadiness3Az: Oracle RAC quorum is configured for 2 nodes only. Adding a third AZ requires re-architecting quorum to 3-node before migration. Redis Sentinel also assumes 2 nodes.

data_persistence.dataResidency: All data must remain within EU-West region. GDPR data subject rights procedures in place.
data_persistence.encryptionAtRest: AES-256 via Oracle TDE. Redis encrypted at OS level (LUKS). Keys managed by CyberArk.
statefulComponents: Shared NFS file store (legacy attachments, 800 GB)

upstream.name: User Directory (LDAP)
upstream.notes: TLS LDAP — server cert tied to current hostname

downstream.name: BI Reporting Platform
downstream.notes: Direct DB connection — hardcoded DB host IP in config

nfrs.peakLoad: 15,000 TPS, 50k concurrent users; Peak 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM EST.
nfrs.autoscaling: Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) via K8s based on CPU/RAM.
nfrs.licensing: Oracle DB per-socket; new instance type requires licensing reassessment with Oracle CSM.

target_architecture.topology3Az: AZ-1: 2× App active, Oracle primary. AZ-2: 2× App active, Oracle replica. AZ-3: App standby, Oracle replica (3-node RAC). Traffic balanced across AZ-1 and AZ-2 via Azure Application Gateway.
target_architecture.dnsIpChanges: erp.corp.com and erp-api.corp.com will point to new Azure Application Gateway IPs. All downstream consumers using hardcoded IPs (BI platform) must update config.
newServicesRequired: Azure Key Vault (replace on-prem CyberArk dependency)

risks.title: Latency issues in DR region
risks.description: App servers in East-US are exceeding 50ms to DB — AZ round-trip sensitivity may cause SLA breach in 3AZ config.
risks.mitigation: Network topology review scheduled with NetEng. Evaluate proximity placement groups in target AZs.

risks.title: SSL Certificate Expiry
risks.description: Certs for dev environment expire in 14 days. Prod cert (erp.corp.com) expires 6 months post-migration — borderline.
risks.mitigation: Renew dev certs immediately. Schedule prod cert renewal as part of migration prep. Confirm Internal CA lead time.

name: User Auth Legacy
description: Completed migration of the legacy Node.js OAuth2/JWT authentication service to an AZ-resilient ECS Fargate deployment with Multi-AZ RDS.

application_overview.businessFunction: Centralised OAuth2 / JWT authentication and session management for internal tooling.

availability.azReadiness3Az: Stateless app layer is 3AZ-ready. Session DB requires replication changes.

downstream.name: CI/CD Pipeline
downstream.notes: Service account tokens issued by auth-svc

nfrs.autoscaling: Not configured — single instance pre-migration; ECS service auto-scaling enabled post-migration.

target_architecture.topology3Az: ECS Fargate service with tasks distributed across AZ-A, AZ-B, AZ-C behind an internal ALB.
target_architecture.dnsIpChanges: auth.internal.company.com updated to new ALB DNS name.

name: Global Edge DNS
description: Large-scale DNS infrastructure migration from on-prem BIND clusters to AWS Route 53 with Anycast edge. APAC and US regions live; EU cutover blocked on propagation TTL issue.

application_overview.businessFunction: Authoritative DNS resolution for all public-facing services across APAC, EU, and US regions.

availability.azReadiness3Az: Fully 3AZ-capable in APAC. EU region still migrating secondary cluster.

data_persistence.dataResidency: Zone data replicated across ap-southeast-1, eu-west-1, us-east-1
data_persistence.encryptionAtRest: N/A — DNS zone data is public

upstream.name: Domain Registrar API
upstream.notes: NS delegation changes require 24h advance notice

nfrs.autoscaling: Route 53 scales automatically. Edge nodes auto-scale via instance groups.
nfrs.licensing: Route 53 pay-per-query. Custom zone DB on PostgreSQL OSS.

migration_constraints.regularMigrationWindow: Rolling — region-by-region with no global maintenance window

target_architecture.topology3Az: Route 53 is inherently multi-AZ. CloudFront edge PoPs cover all 3 AZs per region automatically.
target_architecture.dnsIpChanges: NS records for company.com updated to Route 53 nameservers in APAC and US. EU NS delegation still pointing to legacy BIND cluster.

risks.title: DNS propagation delay
risks.description: Global DNS changes taking longer than expected to propagate. EU region TTL pre-lowering did not complete on schedule, delaying the NS delegation swap.
risks.mitigation: Reduce TTL to 60s 48 hours before cutover. Monitor propagation from 15 global vantage points using dnschecker.org and internal tooling.

risks.title: EU BIND Cluster Hardware EOL
risks.description: The on-prem BIND hardware in the EU region reaches end-of-life in June 2026. If EU cutover is not completed before then, a hardware refresh will be required to maintain support.
risks.mitigation: Escalated EU cutover as P1 blocker. Target completion by April 2026.
